# Belize SEO Agency

> Belize SEO Agency (belizeseoagency.com) helps Belize businesses (hotels, restaurants, dive shops, tour operators, real estate and service businesses) get found on Google and in AI search, with SEO, AI search optimization, web design and marketing. Bilingual (English and Spanish via an on-page toggle).

## Pages
- [Home](https://belizeseoagency.com/): services, a customers-per-week calculator, NFC review and booking funnels, FAQ and a lead form

## Key facts
- Run by Eye To Ad Media, a digital marketing agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, in business since 2012
- No ranking guarantees; clients own their domain, website, Google Business Profile and ad accounts
